name: Build Team
description: This team is in charge of designing and building the robot BEFORE Week Zero.

roles.name: Build Captain
roles.description: Leads the build team and coordinates modeling, prototyping, and building.

roles.name: Build Member
roles.description: Helps the team build the robot.

name: Programming Team
description: This team is in charge of coding and testing the robot.

roles.name: Programming Captain
roles.description: Organizes programming goals, reviews code, and helps test the robot

roles.name: Programming Member
roles.description: Helps the team program the robot.

name: Electrical Team
description: This team is in charge of wiring the robot.

roles.name: Electrical Captain
roles.description: Leads the electrical team in wiring and wire organization.

roles.name: Electrical Member
roles.description: Aids the electrical team in wiring the robot efficiently and effectively.

name: Outreach
description: Reaches out to potential sponsors to fund our robotics team

roles.name: Outreach Member
roles.description: Sends out emails to companies to help financially aid the team.

name: Media
description: Promotes our team and shares upcoming events through social media.

roles.name: Media Member
roles.description: Directs photography, video, and social media content for the team.

name: Strategy Team
description: This team is in charge of watching matches during competitions and relaying information about other robots back to the Drive Coach/Drive Team.

roles.name: Strategy Member
roles.description: In charge of robot data collection during matches.

name: Drive Team
description: This team is responsible for competing in the matches.

roles.name: Buttons/Operator
roles.description: Manages controls and game piece manipulation mid-match.

roles.name: Drive Coach
roles.description: Helps direct match strategy and communicates with drivers during competition.

roles.name: Human Player
roles.description: Launches game pieces into goals mid-match to gain points for the alliance.

roles.name: Technician
roles.description: Helps with match setup by delivering and removing the robot from the field alongside looking for possible damage to the robot.

name: Others
description: This section is for other important roles that are independent of the other categories, but crucial to the team.

roles.name: Team Captain
roles.description: Team captain is the captain of captains. They are responsible for the organization of the team throughout the season by delegating tasks to the other captains.

roles.name: Safety Captain
roles.description: Responsible for the overall safety of the team. Enforces safe practices for the entire team.
